subject.title: feat: unify external sessions with native catalog pagination

question: Should an active Codex plugin expose operator session metadata and transcripts when an existing installation explicitly has `supervision.enabled: false`?
rationale: The PR changes an existing opt-out’s consent meaning; implementation review cannot determine the intended product and security boundary.

options.title: Preserve existing opt-out
options.body: Keep `supervision.enabled: false` authoritative for catalog exposure and add separately named explicit catalog consent if zero-config visibility is desired.

options.title: Approve catalog-by-activation
options.body: Define plugin activation as sufficient operator consent, then document and prove the upgrade and least-privilege behavior.

options.title: Pause catalog rollout
options.body: Retain the existing catalog behavior until maintainers define the permanent consent contract.

recommendation.title: Preserve existing opt-out
recommendation.body: Keep `supervision.enabled: false` authoritative for catalog exposure and add separately named explicit catalog consent if zero-config visibility is desired.

likelyOwner.reason: The canonical issue and PR are authored and assigned to steipete, who also introduced the relevant current session-creation ownership path.
